provenance.provider: UK Polar Data Centre / British Antarctic Survey
provenance.custodian_note: Only JR15001 had soundings around the H10N1 area of interest in the checked BAS/PDC holdings; data are raw and uncorrected.

blind_procedure: Do not inspect bathymetric morphology, rendered surfaces, hillshade, point clouds, or swath-derived relief before the intersection gate is decided.
Perform only container/integrity checks needed to verify the frozen ZIP hash and preserve original bytes.
Parse only navigation/time/beam-footprint information strictly necessary to determine whether the frozen H10N1 coordinate is geometrically intersected by the raw EM122 swath.
Predefine the geometric inclusion rule and tolerance before reading any depth or morphology values at or around H10N1.
Return EXACT_H10N1_SWATH_INTERSECTION as PASS, FAIL, or UNRESOLVED with machine-readable provenance and without describing seafloor shape.
Only after that result is frozen may JANUS open the morphology branch.
No retargeting, coordinate nudging, nearest-feature substitution, or reinterpretation of the target after seeing the data.
